type Attempt = { execution: number; retry: number; review: number; fix: number; context: number };

export function effectiveCost(attempts: readonly Attempt[], accepted: number): number | null {
  if (!Number.isInteger(accepted) || accepted < 0 || accepted > attempts.length) {
    throw new RangeError('Invalid accepted count');
  }
  let total = 0;
  for (const attempt of attempts) {
    for (const cost of [attempt.execution, attempt.retry, attempt.review, attempt.fix, attempt.context]) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(cost) || cost < 0) throw new RangeError('Invalid cost');
      total += cost;
    }
  }
  return accepted === 0 ? null : total / accepted;
}
